source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Coordinate services and resources across settings to support client goals, continuity, and safe transitions","B":"Replace every other healthcare professional so one case manager provides all treatment and coordination","C":"Make medical decisions without client participation because coordination requires centralized authority","D":"Provide bedside procedures only and avoid communication with community and specialty care services"}}
source_row.rationale: CMSA's Standards of Practice frame case management as a professional, client-centered process across the healthcare continuum. Coordination, communication, resource linkage, transitions, and advocacy are core functions rather than replacing other clinicians or excluding the client.
source_row.source_detail: 2022 Standards of Practice with 2024 DEIB/Health Equity addendum; case-management process supports client-centered coordination and continuity across the healthcare continuum.
source_row.source_name: Case Management Society of America — Standards of Case Management Practice
source_row.stem: A client with complex chronic illness is assigned a professional case manager. Which activity is most consistent with case management practice?
